High Vibration.rationale: High vibration is most commonly caused by bearing wear or misalignment
Secondary cause if bearing inspection is clean

High Discharge Pressure.action: Check downstream valve position and line blockage
High Discharge Pressure.rationale: Elevated discharge pressure typically indicates restricted flow downstream

Low Flow.action: Inspect suction strainer and check for cavitation
Low Flow.rationale: Low flow with stable pressure often indicates a suction-side restriction
